subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2433
title: Provides that a public body may not discriminate against, or grant preferential treatment to, any individual or group on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin in the operation of public employment, public education or public contracting.
headline: HB 2433 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2433 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2433 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
